How to use it

A day-by-day plan comes with the book

Open the plan, do that day's pages, tick it off. No time wasted deciding what to study.

  1. Days 1–7Static GKPolity, history, geography, science and culture tables.
  2. Days 8–14FormulasQuant formula cards and reasoning tricks, then the solved questions.
  3. Days 15–20Current AffairsThe 2026 capsule, one-liners first.
  4. Days 21–25EnglishGrammar rules, idioms, one-word substitution.
  5. Days 26–30Mocks & recallPractise full papers and re-read the pages you got wrong.

Fewer than 30 days before your slot? Do two plan days a day and finish in 15. Every page is short enough for it.

Questions

Before you buy

Q1What exactly will I get?

Two PDF files of the same 104-page book: a Dark edition for reading on your phone and a Light edition for daylight reading or printing. You get the download link right after payment.

Q2Will it open properly on my phone?

Yes. The pages are sized for a phone screen, so text is readable without zooming. It opens in any PDF app, and the contents page and bookmarks take you straight to any topic.

Q3Is this enough for Tier-1?

It's a revision book. It packs the highest-yield facts, formulas and rules from all four sections into one place, so you can go over everything quickly before the exam. It works best if you've already studied the syllabus and you pair it with mock tests.

Q4How recent are the current affairs?

Part 3 covers January to September 2026. The book was last updated on 16 September 2026.

Q5Are these official SSC material or actual TCS questions?

No. ScoreSutra is an independent publisher, not linked to the Staff Selection Commission or TCS. The book is original revision material, built around topics that come up often in TCS-conducted SSC papers.

Q6What's in the 10-mock add-on?

Ten full-length papers of 100 questions each (Reasoning, General Awareness, Quant and English, 25 each). Each paper comes with an OMR sheet, an answer key, a score calculator and a written step-by-step solution for every question. The questions are original practice questions, not official papers.

Q7Is there a Hindi version?

Not yet. The book is in English only for now.

Q8What if the file doesn't open or I have a problem?

Because it's an instant digital download, the file can't be returned once it's downloaded. If a file doesn't open or something looks wrong, message us and we'll sort it out.
